title: Рап Пэл
style: Russian rap with clapping percussion, dembow bounce, and alt-R&B vocal lifts; verse rides sparse handclaps, sub hits, and tight rhythmic phrasing, pre-chorus opens into pitched kid-voice doubles, chorus snaps with chanty call-and-response and short ad-lib stacks. Add glitchy app-notification stabs, reverse swells into drops, and tiny vocal chops between lines. Bright, punchy, modern club mix with glossy low end and clean high vocal sheen., bounce, rap, latin, alternative r&b
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
russian lyrics only
clap and rap
rappal.app
rap pal dot app

ты понял, пал?
я понял, пал
я в такт иду
я в ритм попал

you got that?
sing it back, pal
я не шучу
я здесь, я мал

wanna dance, pal
dance, dance, pal
я в круг зайду
и не уйду

latin america, pal
go to pal dot dance
я на связи, пал
give me that шанс

[Pre-Chorus]
alt r&b
и голос выше
kid computer voices
под крышу

be my song, pal
say it again
song pal dot a i
снова, amen

[Chorus]
rap back, pal
rap back, pal
bounce on it
bounce, bounce, pal

song pal
song pal dot a i
sing it here
sing it everywhere

rap back, pal
рап-пал, пал
dance with me
дай мне вайб, давай
